d: What is quantum decoherence and why does it matter? In this video, we explain quantum decoherence in simple words — from the symphony orchestra analogy (harmony turning to chaos when outsiders interfere) to how quantum systems lose superposition through environmental interactions. Learn what coherence means, why Schrödinger's cat is both dead and alive, why quantum computers need extreme cold and isolation, and how decoherence is the biggest obstacle to reliable quantum technology.
